about_the_game:
Science Fiction reaches across a broad spectrum of stories and this map pack lets you experience new ones!

Descend to the center of the earth with Center of the Earth, navigate a colliding with Multiverse Colliding, cross the craziness of timeline divergence with Diverging Timelines, journey to the beginning or end of the earth with Timeline, cross the habitable ring of an inhospitable planet with The Ring, or break into a spacebase with The Citadel.

Unlocking this pack enables you to host games for all players of Journey Quest, even those who have not unlocked the pack themselves.
